checks.message: Provisional boundary is explicitly labeled and does not block content scoring; official polygon triggers full recalculation.
All three provisional key areas are present and explicitly limited to conceptual design.
Land-use partition is generated sequentially from the same site geometry with no gap or overlap.
Twelve scenario cards include data minimization, human review, operation and exit boundaries; four are test/validation scenarios.
Static responsive HTML uses only local submission assets and no scripts, remote resources, forms or tracking.
Proposal references every standard, design-depth item, required geometry file and known metric.
Generation method, public/cleared sources, font and license boundaries are documented.
